description:
Hardware monitor for Windows 11 with processor, graphics, memory and drive sensors.

Thermalyn reads processor, graphics, memory and drive sensors and keeps a 15-minute history.
It offers Mini, Compact, Balanced and Detailed views that adapt to the window size, an English,
French, Spanish and German interface, dark and light themes, and per-component warm and critical
thresholds with a history of every crossing.

Sensors are selected by exact name and never inferred, so a reading that cannot be identified is
reported as absent rather than approximated.

It runs entirely offline: no account, no telemetry and no background service.
What changed
- Settings now states that Thermalyn is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 and
  carries no warranty, with a link to the source code for the running version. The notice is
  translated into the four interface languages.
- Every source file carries an SPDX copyright and licence notice, so the terms travel with a file
  that is read or copied outside the repository.

Which file do I download?
─────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Thermalyn-Setup-1.3.1.exe        │Start here. Installs Thermalyn, adds a Start menu entry and an uninstaller, and sets up the sensor driver. Downloads the .NET runtime if your machine does not have it.
─────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Thermalyn-Portable-1.3.1.exe     │No installation at all. A single file: put it where you like, a USB stick included, and run it.
─────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Thermalyn-Setup-Offline-1.3.1.exe│The same installer, with the .NET runtime already inside. For a machine with no internet connection.
─────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
You only need one of the three.
Windows shows a reputation warning the first time, because the file is not code-signed:
choose More info, then Run anyway.
SHA256SUMS.txt lists the checksum of each file, if you want to confirm a download
arrived intact.

Checking that a file is genuine
Every executable carries a signed build provenance attestation. It proves the file was
produced by this repository's workflow, from this tag, and not modified since. With the
GitHub CLI:
gh attestation verify Thermalyn-Setup-1.3.1.exe --repo NoaSansH/Thermalyn
You can also look each file up on VirusTotal by its checksum:
- Thermalyn-Portable-1.3.1.exe
- Thermalyn-Setup.exe
- Thermalyn-Setup-1.3.1.exe
- Thermalyn-Setup-Offline-1.3.1.exe
Thermalyn is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. These executables
were built by GitHub Actions from this tag, so their complete corresponding source is the
repository at this same tag.
